name: markedin
description: Connect ChatGPT to Markedin to search customers, read customer details and notes, review reminders and calendar activity, and generate activity reports.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to your Markedin account. Search accessible customers, read customer details and notes, review notifications, recurring reminders and calendar events, list assigned employees where permitted, and generate activity reports from recorded customer activity. Access is limited to data available to the authenticated Markedin account and its role permissions. The plugin provides read and reporting workflows; it does not create, modify or delete customers, notes, reminders or calendar events, and it does not process subscription purchases inside ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Show my reminders and calendar events for today.
Generate my Markedin activity report for this month.

positive.description: Search for an accessible customer by name.
positive.prompt: Find the customer Biolas in Markedin.
positive.expected_behavior: Search the authenticated user's permitted Markedin customer markers for Biolas and return matching customer results using only data returned by Markedin.

positive.description: Open a customer's details after finding it.
positive.prompt: Find Biolas and show me its customer details and recent notes.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the matching accessible marker, then return its Markedin details, contacts and recent notes from the selected result.

positive.description: Read the note history for a selected customer.
positive.prompt: Find Biolas and show me its notes from September 2026. Use Europe/Ljubljana.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the accessible Biolas marker and return its notes within the requested September 2026 local-date range, including the note text and available visit metadata.

positive.description: Review reminders and calendar activity for a specified local date.
positive.prompt: Show my Markedin reminders and calendar events for 2 October 2026. Use Europe/Ljubljana.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the authenticated user's matching recurring-reminder occurrences and calendar events for 2 October 2026 in Europe/Ljubljana, without inventing items that Markedin did not return.

positive.description: Generate an activity report over a fixed date range.
positive.prompt: Generate my Markedin activity report for 1 to 30 September 2026. Use Europe/Ljubljana.
positive.expected_behavior: Generate an activity report for the authenticated user's allowed Markedin owners over the requested inclusive date range, summarizing dated notes and verified visits returned by Markedin.

negative.description: Do not delete customer data because the submitted Markedin integration has no destructive customer-delete tool.
negative.prompt: Delete the customer Biolas from Markedin.

negative.description: Do not create customer records because the submitted Markedin integration is read and reporting only.
negative.prompt: Create a new Markedin customer called Review Test Customer at 1 Test Street.

negative.description: Do not modify calendar events because the submitted Markedin integration does not provide calendar write tools.
negative.prompt: Move my Markedin appointment tomorrow to 15:00.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Markedin subscriptions are purchased and managed separately outside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission of the Markedin ChatGPT integration with customer search, customer details and notes, reminders and calendar activity, employee lookup, profile access, and field activity reporting through the Markedin MCP server.
